PATHOPHYSIOLOGY AND INFLAMMATION
Inflammation plays an important role in health and disease. 
The inflammatory process normally occurs to protect and re-
pair tissue damaged by infections, injuries, toxicity, or wounds 
via accumulation of fluid and cells. Once the cause is resolved, 
the inflammation usually subsides. Whether inflammation is
